summary: Wyndham Hotels & Resorts filed an 8-K disclosing the CEO's ongoing cancer treatment (he will continue working) and the planned departure of the Chief Accounting Officer with an internal succession. These are ordinary personnel disclosures, not a forced or abrupt management change constituting a special situation. The filing also reports annual meeting voting results on routine director elections and advisory proposals. No strategic transaction, activist campaign, or special corporate event is announced. The filing is standard for a public company and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
